newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan parties to pass extra budget this month - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan parties to pass extra budget this month - Jiji.

text.p: A decision to pass an extra budget by the end of January for the current fiscal year has been reached between the ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) and two smaller parties that support it in a loose alliance, Jiji news agency said on Friday.

It quoted Taku Yamasaki, chairman of LDP's policy-making council, as saying that officials of the three parties also agreed to get parliament's approval by the end of March for the full state budget for the year starting on April 1.
